verses.1: Let nations listen, and let men hear. The earth will be filled with noise, and the sea and all its inhabitants will be filled with noise as well.
verses.2: For Jehovah is angry with all the nations, and his wrath is upon all their armies. They have been punished for their sins.
verses.3: And their bodies will be thrown away; their corpses will be burned in flames. Their remains will be gathered from the mountains.
verses.4: And all the nations in heaven will be destroyed, and all the records of heaven will be lost. All those nations will be destroyed, just as Nimrod was destroyed from Giphon, and like Cain was destroyed from Abel.
verses.5: For the heavens have fallen upon the earth. Now, judgment will be brought down upon Adam and his people.
verses.6: The altar of Jehovah was filled with blood from sacrificed animals. It was made of meat and bones, along with the intestines of sheep. This was a sacrifice to Jehovah in Beth-El. It was a great sacrifice in the land of Edom.
verses.7: And they brought down sheep with them, along with their shepherds. Their land was covered with blood, and their fields were filled with dung.
verses.8: For the day of judgment for Jehovah will come, a time of peace for all those who have fought against each other.
verses.9: And its valleys became deserts, and its hills became barren lands. It became a land of thorns and weeds.
verses.10: The night and the day will never be extinguished. Its light will continue from generation to generation. It will never be destroyed forever. There’s no limit to its duration.
verses.11: And they inherited Kaat, Kipod, Yanshof, and Eorav. They settled there, and Qawthohu and Avnei Boahu also lived there.
verses.12: Her horses will not be able to carry her; she will have no king to rule over her. All her servants will be destroyed.
verses.13: And on its terraces stood pots and vessels, filled with wine. It was like a forest of trees, with their branches reaching up to the sky.
verses.14: And the lions met the calves. But the lion’s voice called out to its prey. There, peace was found for Lilith, and she found comfort.
verses.15: She was caught in a storm, and she disappeared. But there, her enemies were defeated.
verses.16: They examined the book of Jehovah, and one of them said, “She is not worthy to be called a woman. Her actions are evil; they did not follow His commands.” For He commanded, and His spirit will carry out His commands.
verses.17: And he gave them land, and his hand divided it for them. They would inherit it for ever, and they would live there from generation to generation.
